thread.title: Dropbox, MaxLinear, TerraForm Power: 'Mad Money' Lightning Round

author: Home
title: Dropbox, MaxLinear, TerraForm Power: 'Mad Money' Lightning Round
text:
Here's what Jim Cramer had to say about some of the stocks during the Mad Money Lightning Round :
Dropbox ( DBX ) : "I'd buy ahead of the quarter. It's terrific down here."
MaxLinear ( MXL ) : "Why buy that one with Texas Instruments ( TXN ) all the way down here?"
TerraForm Power ( TERP ) : "I think it's OK, but it's risky. I'd go with Dominion Midstream Partners ( DM ) which just raised their yield. "
American Capital Agency ( AGNC ) : "You'll be getting a big yield but losing on your principle. I also don't like Annaly Capital ( NLY ) ."
World Fuel Services ( INT ) : "I've looked at this one. There's not a lot of upside."
Applied Optoelectronics ( AAOI ) : "Fiber networks are so hard. There are so many easier ways to make money. I'm saying stay away."
Pitney Bowes ( PBI ) : "No, no. That yield is a red flag."
Vodafone Group ( VOD ) : "I don't understand why they're doing so poorly, but that yield tells me there's too much risk."
